brief:
Israeli occupation forces began bulldozing dozens of dunams of agricultural land in the Palestinian town of Deir Ballut, west of Salfit, on Sunday morning, Shehab Wire reported. The operation is part of ongoing Israeli incursions that have repeatedly targeted Palestinian territory across the West Bank region.

Jihad al-Qasem, mayor of Deir Ballut, confirmed the land seizure. The municipality has faced repeated incidents of land confiscation and demolition as Israeli forces continue operations in areas west of Salfit, a governorate in the central West Bank.
